source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Classify a motion as circular when the object's path is circular.

intelligence.enrichment: When an object moves along a circular path, its motion is called circular motion. circular path -> circular motion classification The learner correctly applies this rule: When an object moves along a circular path, its motion is called circular motion. Circular motion is any repeated playground motion, or any motion involving a round-looking setup.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Measurement of length and motion. The student must decide: Classify a motion as circular when the object's path is circular. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. Recalculate the key; do not copy source.key. Every option must be a claim that could answer the stem, and wrong options must be the same kind of answer as the key (a next term, a named process, or a row of the same shape). If the stem continues a number list, every option names a next term. Never write that naming or writing a term is what creates the list. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, n
